items.source: Implementations are free to return null to indicate absence of a value or wrap the result into any generally supported Optional type.
items.translation: 实现可以返回 null 以表示值的缺失，也可以将结果包装为任何通用的受支持的 `Optional` 类型。

items.source: SPI to customize which property of an entity is used as unique identifier and how the entity instance is looked up from the backend. Prefer to extend EntityLookupSupport to let the generics declaration be used for the Plugin.supports(Object) method automatically.
items.translation: SPI 用于自定义实体的哪个属性用作唯一标识符，以及后端如何查找该实体实例。建议扩展 EntityLookupSupport，以便让泛型声明自动应用于Plugin.supports(Object) 方法。

items.source: Returns the property of the given entity that shall be used to uniquely identify it. If no EntityLookup is defined for a particular type, a standard identifier lookup mechanism (i.e. the datastore identifier) will be used to eventually create an identifying URI.
items.translation: 返回给定实体应使用以唯一标识该实体的属性。如果未为特定类型定义 EntityLookup，则将使用标准标识符查找机制（即数据存储标识符）来最终创建标识 URI。

items.source: Returns the lookup property if available. If Optional.empty() is returned, we assume the identifier property is the one to be used for lookup.
items.translation: 如果可用，则返回查找属性。如果返回的是 Optional.empty()，我们假设标识符属性是用于查找的属性。

items.source: Returns the lookup property if available.
items.translation: 如有可用，则返回查找属性。

items.source: Returns the property of the given entity that shall be used to uniquely identify it.
items.translation: 返回用于唯一标识给定实体的属性。

items.source: Returns the entity instance to be used if an entity with the given identifier value is requested.
items.translation: 返回在请求具有给定标识符值的实体时所使用的实体实例。

items.source: Returns the entity instance to be used if an entity with the given identifier value is requested. Implementations will usually forward the call to a repository method explicitly and can assume the given value be basically the value they returned in getResourceIdentifier(Object).
items.translation: 返回在请求给定标识符值的实体时所使用的实体实例。实现通常会显式地将调用转发到存储库方法，并且可以假定给定的值基本上就是它们在getResourceIdentifier(Object)中返回的值。
